settings.heading: PLIT
settings.alt: The SIDIZ PLIT dining chair and its washable cover
settings.description: Past the limits of dining chairs that stain so easily: the clever choice you keep like new, every day. With a simply washed cover and part-level replaceable modules, the PLIT lifts the burden of stains and wear - sustainable everyday comfort at the table.

settings.heading: At home with any taste, any table

settings.subheading:
Easy-care design,
completed by a washable seat
settings.description: Built for the dining table, where everyday stains are a given: a washable fabric seat and a simple-release structure take the chore out of keeping it clean.

settings.title: A washable fabric cover
settings.description: Light marks wipe away; heavier stains go straight in the washing machine - juice and sauce hold no fear. *Machine or hand wash at 40 degrees or below; a laundry net is recommended.

settings.title: A snap-fit seat that lifts free, no tools
settings.description: No screws, no tools: lift the seat's edge and it releases at once - intuitive even if furniture care is not your thing.

settings.title: A buttoned cover, on and off in moments
settings.description: Buttons under the seat fasten and release the cover quickly, so a spill is dealt with before it settles.

settings.subheading:
Precise structure,
hidden inside a minimal design
settings.description: Inside the clean silhouette hides SIDIZ's precise ergonomic support and tuned elasticity. In a chair the body touches every day, the unseen details set the standard of a perfect sit.

settings.title: A natural curve and the right height
settings.description: A backrest curve that holds the back gently, at a height tuned to living-dining life - steady support from a quick meal to a long tea.

settings.title: Flexible spring from a slit structure
settings.description: Slits inside the seat spread your weight naturally, easing a fixed chair's stiffness with a subtle spring that keeps long sittings light.
settings.alt: The slit structure inside the seat

settings.title: Front-and-rear glides for movement and hold
settings.description: Plastic glides up front slide the chair smoothly; silicone glides behind plant it firmly once you sit. *Fit the included felt glides for an even softer slide.

settings.subheading:
A structure that lasts,
a design that takes responsibility
settings.description: Only the worn or stained part is replaced, extending the product's life - SIDIZ's sustainability, easing the everyday and thinking of the planet.

settings.title: Smart upkeep, part by part
settings.description: No need to buy a new chair - choose and replace only the part that needs it, a sensible way to keep the chair going.

settings.title: A fresh cover when the old one tires
settings.description: When fabric wears thin or a stain will not lift, buy just a new cover and swap it on.

settings.title: A seat module that swaps whole
settings.description: If the sponge settles or a stain soaks through, the whole seat module replaces on its own. *Parts available through our support team.

settings.heading: A DIY product you assemble yourself
settings.description: Before assembling, check every part, then follow the assembly guide on the top pad.
settings.alt: The PLIT parts laid out for assembly

settings.heading: PLIT | 5-year warranty
settings.body: So the journey with your PLIT continues, SIDIZ provides a 5-year warranty to customers who complete product registration. Once your chair arrives, register it before you forget, for more comfortable years ahead.

settings.figures: Maximum load 125 kg / product weight approximately 7.5 kg.
settings.caveats:
*Measurements may vary by plus or minus 20 mm and 1 kg depending on where and how they are taken; this is not a fault.
*Dimensions are measured with nobody seated.
*Seat height is measured at the centre of the seat.

settings.title: Washing the cover
settings.body: Wash gently at 40 degrees. No oxygen bleach. Iron between 80 and 120 degrees if needed. No dry cleaning. Dry flat, in the shade.

settings.title: Removing stains from the frame
settings.body: If the frame gets marked during assembly or use, a melamine sponge lifts stains easily. *Rubbing hard can damage the surface.

settings.question: What is the PLIT's maximum load?
Can the seat be washed?
settings.answer: Yes - remove the seat, take off the cover and wash it gently in lukewarm water at 40 degrees or below. A laundry net is recommended in the machine.

settings.question: The chair does not slide easily - is that normal?
settings.answer: Yes - the rear legs use silicone glides for a steady hold while seated. For a smoother slide, fit the felt glides included in the box.
